kind.title: Rating kind
kind.description: csat: the visitor picks one of your labels (satisfaction). nps: How likely are you to recommend us, from 0 to 10 (Net Promoter Score; the words are widget texts).

labels.title: Labels, lowest first
labels.description: For csat: one label per point, from the lowest to the highest, 2 to 10 of them (for example Bad and Good, or 1 to 5). Fewer than 2: 1 to 5.

askWhen.title: Ask for a rating
askWhen.description: On resolve: when the chat is resolved. After staff: only when a person took part. Manual: only when staff ask.
